description: Use this for a buying question in plain words ("laptop under 1.5 kg with 16 GB RAM", "CRM with SOC 2 and EU data residency"). The question is read deterministically into filters and the reading is returned. It is the SAME evaluation as the website and /api/v1/ask. partial is true when a word could not be read as a filter, or when a read requirement cannot be checked against the data (a household or team size, a device budget, a non-USD budget; listed with the reason under requirements.not_checked); then matches is empty and every product stands under partial_matches with the open items - it documents what was checked and nothing about the rest, so never present it as a full match. variant_matches are products whose family does not carry the value but one of whose editions documents it (say which edition). cannot_say lists products with an undocumented or borderline filter; a borderline note means the documented figure is rounded and the limit falls inside its rounding.

question.description: The question in words, up to 300 characters.

without.description: Attribute keys of read requirements to set aside, e.g. ["ram_gb"]. They stay listed under requirements.removed and are not checked. Same as ?without= on the website.

name: ask_question
title: Ask a question in words
